title: Head Track
description: Head tracking for the player using Opentrack. Supports 6DoF movement.
body:
Head Track adds head-tracking support through OpenTrack UDP data. It lets compatible tracking software drive the in-game camera and player head pose.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/4hy27vqDvTs" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## Features
- Receives OpenTrack-style UDP head pose data, using port `4242` by default
- Applies tracked yaw, pitch, and roll to the camera and rendered player head
- Supports optional camera translation for 6DoF-style movement
- Includes hybrid and independent head/crosshair modes
- Can limit tracked rotation, adjust sensitivity, and freeze tracking while menus are open
- Syncs tracked head poses between players when the mod is installed on the server

## Compatible Tools
Use any head-tracking tool that can output OpenTrack UDP data to `127.0.0.1:4242`, for instance:
- [OpenTrack](https://github.com/opentrack/opentrack)
- [Head Track](https://store.steampowered.com/app/4214760/HeadTrack/), if configured to output OpenTrack UDP data
